description: Collect what support or a developer needs to follow one chat: its slug and link, the newest messages as ids, role, time, model, provider, status, tool call counts and any stored failure notice with its reference, the connectors with host and mode (over MCP only, never in a chat), your experimental features, the app build and the server time. Returns the structured data and one plain-text report to copy. Never returns message text, tool input or output, keys, tokens, connector addresses beyond the host or share links. The connectors need the connectors:read scope and the features the settings:read scope. Requires signing in (chats:read).

maxMessages.description: Newest messages to include, 1 to 20. Defaults to 10

slug.description: Chat slug from list_chats. Inside a Besidka chat it defaults to the current chat. Leave it out for account-level information only

name: get_debug_info
title: Get debug info
